name: GlowAssist — WhatsApp Appointment Reminders & Conversation Logger

nodes.name: Cron — Every Hour (Reminder Check)
nodes.notes: Fires every hour. The filter nodes below select only appointments that start in ~24h or ~2h.

nodes.name: Fetch 24-Hour Appointments
nodes.notes: Fetches scheduled appointments within the next 24-25 hours window.

nodes.name: Filter — Exactly 24h Window
nodes.notes: Keeps only appointments 23-25 hours from now so each runs exactly once per appointment.

nodes.name: Log 24h Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: Optional: logs reminder sent into appointment_logs table. Skips gracefully if endpoint not active.

nodes.name: Fetch 2-Hour Appointments
nodes.notes: Fetches today's scheduled appointments — filter node below narrows to 2h window.

parameters.textBody:

nodes.name: Cron — Daily Conv Log (3 AM)
nodes.notes: Fires daily at 3 AM to archive yesterday's conversation transcripts.

nodes.name: Fetch Yesterday WhatsApp Msgs
nodes.notes: Calculates yesterday's date for conversation log archiving.

nodes.name: Archive AI Conversation Log
nodes.notes: POSTs a request to the backend to archive conversation transcripts into crm_live_chats table. Fails silently if endpoint not yet active.

nodes.name: Log Archive Complete
nodes.notes: Logs archive result to n8n execution logs for audit trail.

notes:
SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Set environment variables in n8n: BACKEND_API_URL, BACKEND_JWT_TOKEN, GEMINI_API_KEY
2. Update phoneNumberId (1093698253829228) to your WhatsApp Business phone number ID
3. Update WhatsApp credentials IDs to match your n8n credential store
4. Activate the workflow — the hourly cron will check for reminders automatically
5. The 24h reminder fires for appointments 23-25h from execution time
6. The 2h reminder fires for appointments 1h45m-2h15m from execution time
7. Both reminders log to the backend appointment_logs table
8. The daily 3AM cron archives conversation transcripts to crm_live_chats
